decisions.reason: As a close extension of core vessel management into offshore and renewable energy, A fits the firm's expansion path and likely merits continued support under a large firm's slack despite limited later website evidence.

Because crew and corporate travel management is tightly complementary to the firm's established crew and administrative services, management would tolerate temporary uncertainty and keep it as part of an end-to-end client offer.

The lack of continued website visibility after launch suggests the portal did not clearly meet aspiration levels, so a boundedly rational management would reallocate resources from this standalone digital service to stronger core or development activities.

With no sign of sustained market presence beyond its launch year and requiring capabilities less central than the firm's service operations, the mobile performance app likely fell short of aspirations and should be discontinued.
